core_idea: LCE E.G.O::Ardor Blossom Star Faust is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist / Support — **Burn** stacker — damage and clash scale with Burn on target. Burn ticks at the end of every turn regardless of what either side does. Scaling conditions: +10% damage per 10 Burn (max +20%). Support passive (**Residual Heat**) applies when allies **land hits**.
playstyle_guide:

- Skills check **10+ Burn** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: +10% damage per 10 Burn (max +20%).
- Hold S3 for when At 30+ Burn is met — that condition is what unlocks its full damage ceiling.
